Q1: Which part of coding-workflows should this issue change?
Choices:
A) The clarify phase (`.github/workflows/ai-clarify.yml` and `prompts/mode-clarify.txt`)
B) The plan or implement phases
C) Review/autofix (`review_autofix.yml` and its `scripts/review_autofix_step_*.sh` helpers)
D) The orchestrator (`orchestrate_poll.yml` and `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`)
E) Docs only (README.md or `docs/`)
F) Something else: please name the file, workflow or script, and describe the current problem in an `/answer` (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What does "better" mean here?
Choices:
A) Fix a bug or failure you have seen: please give the run ID, log excerpt or PR/issue number (RECOMMENDED)
B) Cut cost or runtime, such as tokens, GitHub API calls or wall-clock time
C) Make it more reliable, such as fewer stalls, retries or flaky runs
D) Make it easier to use, such as clearer comments, alerts or docs
E) Add a new capability: please describe it
Q3: How will we know the change worked?
Choices:
A) A specific failing scenario or test now passes: please describe it (RECOMMENDED)
B) A metric you can measure improves: please name the metric and the target
C) The docs or output read more clearly, judged by review
